en.paragraph: President Bukele publicly denied reports that his government is reviewing half of all gang-related cases, insisting no gang member will be freed. For you as a coastal or lake property buyer, this signals the security crackdown that made El Salvador's beaches and lakes attractive is staying in place for now. Expect continued stability, but keep watching for legal or human-rights pushback that could shift policy and affect investor confidence.
en.title: Bukele: No Gang Member Will Ever Be Released

es.paragraph: El turismo en El Salvador está en pleno auge, superando a destinos como Cuba y Costa Rica. Esto significa más visitantes y mayor demanda de alojamiento, lo que puede aumentar el valor de las propiedades costeras y de lago. Si estás pensando en comprar, ahora es un buen momento para invertir, ya que el crecimiento turístico podría traducirse en mejores rendimientos de alquiler y plusvalía a futuro.
es.title: El Salvador consolida su auge turístico superando a Cuba y Costa Rica
